snippet.title: The Division 2: Year 5 Season 3 - VANGUARD Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Year 5 Season 3 "Vanguard" is available now, Agents. Discover the comprehensive list of fixes, updates, and quality of life changes that make up Project Resolve, the first big step in our on-going, long-term commitment to supporting and improving The Division 2. Find out more ➡ https://thedivision2.com/y5s3-vanguard
